_comment: Parks-and-Recreation word lists for automatic player names. js/board/names.js mirrors these as a JS literal (the browser has no build step and cannot rely on JSON module imports); tools/names.test.mjs asserts the two are identical. The vocabulary is NOT capped so that every pair fits — the CROSS PRODUCT is filtered instead. Build the valid pair set as every [modifier, subject] where modifier.length + 1 + subject.length <= maxNameLength, and draw only from that set; validPairCount is what a correct filter must produce.
